info.title: Rigbox Auth API
info.description: Auth-service-owned public API surface exported for gateway composition.

get.description: List the role bindings (principal, role, resource) configured on your account.

post.description: Create a role binding granting a principal a role on a resource.

delete.description: Delete a role binding, revoking that principal's access to the resource.

patch.description: Update an existing role binding, changing its role or resource scope.

get.description: List the principals on your account that can be granted access-control roles.
List the built-in role presets and the actions each one grants.

post.description: Simulate whether a principal would be allowed an action on a resource.

get.description: Get the access-control tags attached to a principal or resource.

put.description: Set the access-control tags on a principal or resource.

get.description: Get the throttle (rate-limit) preset bound to a resource.

put.description: Bind a throttle (rate-limit) preset to a resource.

get.description: List the available throttle presets and their rate-limit settings.
List your account's API keys (metadata only; secrets are never returned).

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description:
Maximum items to return. Clamped to `[1, MAX_LIMIT]`. Default 50.

Deserialized leniently from a string: axum's `Query` (serde_urlencoded)
cannot coerce a *flattened* numeric field, so a struct that
`#[serde(flatten)]`s `PageParams` (e.g. `ListAppsQuery`) would otherwise
fail with "invalid type: string, expected u32" on `?max_results=50`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor returned by a prior call's `next_cursor`. Omit on the
first page.

post.description: Create a full-account API key; the plaintext secret is returned only once.

delete.description: Revoke an API key by ID; requests using it stop working immediately.

delete.summary: Delete the account and everything it owns.
delete.description: Immediately disables the account, revokes its credentials and starts deleting its workspaces, apps, snapshots, published recipes, Stripe customer and sign-in identity. `confirm_email` must equal the account email (case-insensitive). Cannot be undone.

403.description: Credential cannot delete the account, or the account is disabled (`Account disabled`) or already being deleted (`Account deleted`)

409.description: A deletion is already in progress

get.summary: Preview what deleting the account removes.
get.description: Counts every resource an account deletion removes, with the subscription, GitHub App and custom-domain state to warn about. Requires a bearer session or an API key.

403.description: Credential cannot manage the account, or the account is disabled (`Account disabled`) or being deleted (`Account deleted`)

204.description: Both identities proved; reload the console

post.summary: Create a pending CLI session. Called by the CLI before opening the browser.
post.description: Open a CLI login session and return a one-time approval code.

get.summary: Poll a CLI session. Called by the CLI while waiting for browser approval.
get.description: Poll a CLI login session for browser approval and its issued API key.

post.summary: Approve a CLI session. Called by the web app after the user logs in.
post.description: Approve a CLI login session from the browser and mint its API key.

post.summary:
POST /auth/force-change-password - Used after admin resets a user's password.
Verifies the temporary password, sets the new one, and clears the must_change_password flag.

409.description: Workspace is inactive or not ready

200.description: The secrets the connection's rig.yaml declares, and whether each has a value. Values are never returned.

409.description: The connection deploys through GitHub Actions, which reads secrets from its workflow

422.description: The branch's rig.yaml does not validate

200.description: Stored; the result lists the names whose value changed

400.description: A name the branch's rig.yaml does not declare, or an empty or oversized value

409.description: The connection deploys through GitHub Actions, or its secrets kept changing during the update

422.description: The branch's rig.yaml does not validate

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Required target when a repository has several workspace bindings

204.description: Binding deleted and deploy tokens revoked

AccountDeletionPreview.description: Everything a deletion would remove, shown before the user confirms.

clerk_identities.description:
Clerk identities recorded for the account: the Clerk users a deletion
removes. 0 means any Clerk user must be removed by hand.

ApiErrorBody.description: JSON body returned for all errors.

Build.description:
Index row for one image build. NOT the build log —
the log text stays in host journald under `rigbox-build-<build_id>`; this row
just lets a user enumerate their recent builds (incl. failures) and resolve
each `build_id` to open its journald log. Owner-scoped.

error.description: Short failure summary — set on failure.

image_digest.description: Content digest of the produced image — set on success.

label.description: Best-effort app/project label from the deploy (the CLI's `rig.yaml` name).

source_commit.description: Full git object ID requested for this build; retained on failure.

source_kind.description:
`recipe` for every build since Dockerfile/image sources were removed;
historical rows may still read `dockerfile` or `image`.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace; standalone image builds have no workspace.

ConfirmAccountDeletion.description: The caller retypes the account email to confirm the deletion.

confirm_email.description: The account email; compared trimmed and case-insensitively.

from.description: The runtime secret its value is stored and supplied under.

set.description: Whether the connection holds a value for `from`.

Page_ApiKeyResponse.description: Paginated response envelope. `next_cursor: None` ⇒ last page.

binding_id.description: The GitHub connection (repository binding) the secrets belong to.

commit.description: The branch head whose rig.yaml declared `secrets`.

updated.description: Update only: the names whose stored value this request changed.

secrets.description:
Values keyed by the runtime-secret names rig.yaml declares (each
entry's `from:`, else its name). Merged into the stored secrets:
names not supplied keep their values.
